metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully subscripted the '2' in 'H2O' in the document title using keyboard navigation and Ctrl+Shift+B, then saved with Ctrl+S.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent can select characters with keyboard, apply character formatting, change paragraph alignment, and save documents.
metadata.explanation: Composes the original subscript task with a paragraph-level formatting change: centering the title paragraph. Getter checks: (1) a run with '2' in the Title paragraph has font.subscript=True, (2) the Title paragraph alignment == WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER (1). Partial credit: 0.5 per sub-goal. Original title alignment is None (not centered), so initial state fails negative control. [Fixed: renamed getter/metric functions from invalid 8-char suffix '3d9d474a' to correct 32-char MD5 hash '49f57bac6148724412fcfb3eb162539d' computed from '0b17a146-2934-46c7-8727-73ff6b6483e8|2']
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter function from 'get_docx_subscript_and_title_center__3d9d474a' to 'get_docx_subscript_and_title_center__49f57bac6148724412fcfb3eb162539d' (invalid 8-char suffix -> correct 32-char MD5 hash)

Fix 2: Renamed metric function from 'check_docx_subscript_and_title_center__3d9d474a' to 'check_docx_subscript_and_title_center__49f57bac6148724412fcfb3eb162539d' (invalid 8-char suffix -> correct 32-char MD5 hash)
Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in task JSON to use corrected 32-char MD5 function names

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the docx file from the Docker environment and parses it with python-docx.
Subscript check correctly identifies whether a run containing '2' in the Title paragraph has font.subscript=True; LibreOffice splits subscripted characters into separate runs when saving as docx.
Center alignment check correctly compares para.alignment to WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER (==1); explicitly setting center in LibreOffice sets this attribute at the paragraph level.
Metric correctly awards 0.5 partial credit per sub-goal (subscript + centering) and returns 0.0 on getter error.
Negative control is satisfied: initial document has non-subscripted '2' and para.alignment==None (not CENTER), so the initial state scores 0.0.

Minor risk: getter locates the title paragraph strictly by style.name=='Title'; if the document's heading uses a different or custom style name, both checks would silently return False and the evaluator would always score 0.0.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: As a fallback, if no paragraph with style.name=='Title' is found, also check the first paragraph or any paragraph whose text contains 'H2O' as the candidate title paragraph.
